name: Outcast Path
summary: Path Benefit Ranger If you do not move before attacking with a ranger long rifle, your first ranged attack this turn gains +2 to hit. Corsair You gain proficiency with pistols and blades. After making a weapon attack, move 5 ft without provoking opportunity attacks. Shadow Guide Gain expertise in Stealth or Survival. You have advantage on checks to navigate ruins, wilderness, alien structures, and webway-adjacent places.
